_comment: The list is bilingual and its CI rejects a PR that touches README.md without
README.zh.md, so both rows live here and scripts/markets.py inserts each one into
its own category table. {{stars}} is replaced with the live GitHub star count.
This file is JSON (not YAML) because the release tooling parses it with the Python
standard library only; the awesome-dsh-plugin entry stays YAML because that market's
file is copied byte for byte.
row_en: | [0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio](https://github.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio) | Self-hosted crypto portfolio dashboard for DSH — BTC, EVM (73 chains), Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid, five exchanges and tokenised equities in one view, with a shareable PNG card, a tunable asset-health report, per-source connection tests and zero-dependency trend charts (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-crypto-portfolio`) | {{stars}} |
row_zh: | [0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio](https://github.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio) | 自托管加密资产仪表盘：BTC、EVM（73 条链）、Solana、狗狗币、艾达币、Hyperliquid、五家交易所与代币化股票统一视图，含可分享 PNG 卡片、可调阈值的资产健康度报告、逐数据源连通性测试与零依赖趋势图（`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-crypto-portfolio` 安装） | {{stars}} |
pr_body: A DSH web plugin: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`, mounts its own profile layer, and serves a self-hosted dashboard (Python standard library + vanilla JS, no CDN) that aggregates on-chain and CEX balances into one view, with daily snapshots turned into trend charts.
From GitHub instead: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio`.
- npm: not published yet — install from GitHub or from the tag tarball
Searched this list for `crypto`, `portfolio` and `0xRabit` — no existing entry, and no cross-category duplicate.
